result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, with a park and playground on the right providing a buffer and greenery. However, the environment lacks marked crossings and traffic calming measures, and on-street parking on the left creates potential visual obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks to facilitate safe access to the park and playground from the residential buildings.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parallel parked vehicles on the left side of the street may block the sightlines of drivers and pedestrians, particularly children.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to provide designated crossing points, especially near the park entrance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or speed cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential and recreational zone.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained concrete sidewalk adjacent to a fenced playground area. Mature trees in pits provide a buffer between the walkway and the roadway, though no active traffic calming or crossing infrastructure is visible in this mid-block section.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The continuous fence and wall along the park boundary limit passive surveillance and street-level engagement.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Surface Debris
hazards.description: Accumulated leaves on the sidewalk can become slippery when wet, posing a minor trip or slip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk surface near the tree pits

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians using the walkway at night.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If there is significant demand for park access, a high-visibility marked crossing would improve pedestrian safety.

result.summary: The image shows a local street with a paved sidewalk on the left side, separated from the roadway by a curb. The right side of the image is heavily obscured by a blur, and there is a lack of visible pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or street lighting.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection in the distance lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background at the stop sign

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, unmarked roadway lacks physical measures to slow vehicle speeds, potentially increasing risk for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a paved sidewalk that is severely obstructed by a utility pole, significantly reducing the effective walking width. The street is narrow with residential buildings located directly at the sidewalk edge, providing no buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is positioned in the middle of the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into a very narrow space or onto the roadway.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the curb edge or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk into the parking lane to create a bypass around the obstruction and provide a buffer from traffic.
